reason: Record the local no-cloud Observatory static-edge implementation.

operation.summary: Added a standalone Terraform and operator-documentation package for the private-S3 and CloudFront-hosted Observatory edge without executing AWS changes.
changes: Added a private versioned S3 origin, CloudFront OAC distribution, us-east-1 ACM certificate, Route53 aliases, and explicit security headers.
Restricted execution to the agent-logic-admin profile and canonical observatory.csm.agent-logic.ai hostname.
Added credential-free Runtime HTTPS/WSS CSP inputs, immutable artifact versioning, invalidation, and S3 object-version rollback guidance.
Strengthened the issue validator to prove concrete resources, controls, redaction, and no-live-mutation policy.
